# merge

This is a merge of pre-trained language models created using [mergekit](https://github.com/cg123/mergekit).

## Merge Details
### Merge Method

This model was merged using the SLERP merge method.

### Models Merged

The following models were included in the merge:
* [jaspionjader/fr-17-8b](https://huggingface.co/jaspionjader/fr-17-8b)
* [FuseAI/FuseChat-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/FuseAI/FuseChat-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct)

### Configuration

The following YAML configuration was used to produce this model:

```yaml
slices:
- sources:
  - model: jaspionjader/fr-17-8b
    layer_range:
    - 0
    - 32
  - model: FuseAI/FuseChat-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
    layer_range:
    - 0
    - 32
merge_method: slerp
base_model: jaspionjader/fr-17-8b
parameters:
  t:
  - filter: self_attn
    value:
    - 0.12
    - 0.13
    - 0.11
    - 0.14
    - 0.13
  - filter: mlp
    value:
    - 0.13
    - 0.12
    - 0.14
    - 0.11
    - 0.12
  - value: 0.93
dtype: bfloat16
```
